# ArqUX

> Open-source framework (v1.0.0) for governed human-AI work — agent identities, project context, scoped work and reviewable evidence in a local-first workspace. One governed source projects native instruction files to every agent harness (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .opencode). ArqUX Platform, the hosted multi-user product, is in development.

## Key facts

- Framework v1.0.0: 115 governance handlers (documented), release suite report in CHANGELOG, codec_cortex 1.0 mandatory (loss==0 fail-closed), seal.cortex SHA-256 manifest, evidence export with privacy gate.
- Multi-harness projection: `arqux sync-harnesses` renders AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / GEMINI.md / .opencode from .arqux/; `arqux drift-check` reports manual edits.
- Task execution: `task.run` runs governed [exec:action] steps under a bound session (UNBOUND_SESSION otherwise); never arbitrary shell.
- Workspaces: deterministic journal CLI (push-delta / pull-policy, ERR_CONFLICT_VERSION on divergence). Hosted multi-user coordination is a Platform direction.
- Memory format: Codec-CORTEX certified — 141/141 idempotence, round-trip, lossless; 101/101 HCORTEX render parity; 5/5 runtime parity.
- Agent bootstrap: `arqux wake --identity <role>` returns a governed payload under 1,500 tokens.

PyPI publishes 0.9.0; the repository declares 1.0.0.
